anomalies.description: Two men engage in mutual physical combat: one in a plaid shirt and jeans jumps toward the other (in white shirt and red vest), who reciprocates with a jump and apparent strike; they make contact mid-air and continue exchanging blows while surrounded by onlookers.
Two men engage in a physical fight involving punches, kicks, and grappling; they are surrounded by onlookers and at times lifted off the ground during the struggle.

A group of young men engage in a chaotic physical altercation involving grappling, pushing, and swinging objects (possibly a bicycle frame or pole) in a street market setting; multiple individuals are actively involved in mutual combat.

The fighting escalates into a broader group disturbance with at least 6–8 participants, including children on bicycles being used as part of the commotion; the scene shows collective violent unrest with coordinated movement and disruption of the environment (e.g., boxes knocked over, bicycles displaced).
